Asset type: one original-size-compatible Hearts of Iron IV character portrait replacement.

Never place the visible mouth above the moustache or turn the moustache into a second beard. Clean-shaven originals stay clean-shaven.

The lower head silhouette curves inward toward its base instead of continuing down as parallel straight yellow sides. Raise and broaden the original collar and shoulders to meet that curved chin; do not insert an extra yellow neck roll underneath it.
Keep the source's fastening state: a buttoned closed standing collar remains closed and buttoned, with both front ends meeting naturally at the center seam. Do not turn a closed military collar into a deep V-neck or unbuttoned shirt. Preserve open lapels/shirt collars only where the original is actually open.
Preserve the source aspect ratio, crop and number of figures. Preserve real alpha transparency, photographic frames, note cards and existing decorative markings where present. Do not add such framing where absent. Polished painterly HOI4 finish, legible at the original in-game size. One source image to one asset. No comparison board, new text, label, watermark or extra figure.

Visible source-specific features: Small adviser photograph card: retain the original dark photograph frame, cream note overlapping its right side, exact silhouette, relative scale, shadow, crop and real outside alpha. Replace only the person inside the photograph and retain the original head angle and gaze. Bareheaded naval officer with short dark receding hair, clean-shaven face and calm forward gaze, navy closed high-collared uniform and original gold shoulder decorations. No invented moustache from lip shading. Use a compact near-round golden mascot head with a short curved chin seated directly inside a broadened fitted cloth collar. Retain the source OPEN/CLOSED fastening and exact garment details. No separate exposed long yellow neck, cream skin bib, floating collar, added headgear, new medals or extra symbols. Retain note markings as existing texture, without invented readable text, labels or new figures.
Final source-specific check: This source is CLEAN-SHAVEN: no moustache, no beard, no chin tuft and no goatee. Keep exposed facial areas smooth yellow; skin shading is not hair.
